[ABC Action News / Tampa Bay 28] Judge denies Karmelo Anthony's request for new trial in deadly stabbing at track meet
item.description: A Texas judge denied a new trial for Karmelo Anthony in the stabbing death of a 17-year-old athlete at a high school track meet.

item.title: [ABC Action News / Tampa Bay 28] Iran’s president says US memorandum is best path out of stalled war
item.description: Iranian President Masoud Pezeshkian defended a recent memorandum of understanding as the best way for the country to move beyond what he described as a situation of “neither war nor peace.”

item.title: [FOX 13 Tampa Bay] Family still searching for missing South Tampa man after jail release: 'We just want you to be safe'
item.description: The desperate search for a missing South Tampa man continues as Tampa police confirm they are still working to determine the 54-year-old’s whereabouts.
